notes.content:
We've been in production of our upcoming RPG for almost a year now along with Angels of Fasaria 3.0 which is looking very promising as well. We will soon open a round table to discuss the game and it's future and have sign ups for a small team of testers.

You can find the link to our website below and also follow us on facebook, twitter and join our Steam group as well.

http://hatefreeheroes.com
http://steamcommunity.com/groups/hatefreeheroes
https://www.facebook.com/hatefreeheroesfans
https://mobile.twitter.com/HateFreeHeroes

We need your help to get it on steam! Please remember to vote so we can get the wheels of this game going.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=701242766
About Hate Free Heroes:

Hate Free Heroes is a modern day role playing game that takes the player into the role of an H.F.H agent and researcher dedicated to decreasing the rise of "Aggromites" in the city.
 
Aggromites/Aggromite (definition) [ag-roh-myht] [noun]: A mischievous entity that influence a person's aggression levels through the "dream world" or altered reality.
 
Join the H.F.H agency, complete major missions and research missions to help the agency discover the reason behind the growing rise in "Aggro". Journey through the city of Newsport to find faithful agents that will join your cause as you begin to unravel the mystery behind the "Aggromite" influx.

• Explore the Large City of Newsport 
• Major Missions and Research Missions to Complete 
• Upgradeable Gear with Gear Slots 
• Steam Achievements 
• Steam Trading Cards

notes.title: AoF World Online: Community Edition is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Great news, we are making great progress with the community edition which will include all of the features and opportunities below. Remember, the community edition and all of it's features and bonuses will be open to everyone who currently owns a copy of AoF World Online and for everyone who purchases this version in the future. 

The Community Edition Will Include:

1. Server Application with Scripts - All players will have the opportunity to play the game locally on their computer independently using the server application. All players can edit the scripts as they see fit and make custom mods to how the game plays like unlimited drops, invincibility etc (these features will be reserved when you play locally on your computer. Modifying scripts will not change the games you play online on our servers). 

*The server and scripts are for single player use. You will NOT be able to host the server for other players to play on. That option is reserved for the Partner Server DLC.

2. Workshop - The workshop will be open and made available for all players to submit modified scripts with their own story versions, language translations, custom mods to the battle system, quests etc. There will also be an option for players to sell their mods or buy mods from other players. We will even include tutorials for the scripting which is very simple to learn and modify.

3. Fasaria World Online free access key - ALL players will get a free access key to create an account and play Fasaria World Online at no addition cost. This offer will become a regular part of the Community Edition and will require no addition fee, requirements to meet or any extra process to earn.  This is a $9.99 value and we will supply one key to be redeemed per account, per game. All you have to do is view your cd key from your game, access Fasaria World Online and register using your free access key. Learn more about the game below:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/398970

4. Art & Media Contests and  Workshop Submissions - We will be organizing contests for Art & Media. Almost anything can be submitted for the game. This will include UI design, story video, menus etc. All content can also be uploaded to the workshop for players to download for free or sale.

5. New Partner Servers Added to Play On - As we get more partners, we'll be adding them to our official server list that  players can choose to play on. Some partner servers will include modified scripts, story, quests etc. Each partner will have their server description and info posted on steam for players to view

6. News and Updates - We will be announcing new user submitted mods and scripts in our news. Every time something new is submitted, we'll make an announcement.

7. We are working hard to add more value to this game and community in spite of some of the challenges we've met along the way. We'll continue to find better ways of improving opportunities for our player base and community.

notes.title: February Newsletter: A Lot of Updates Coming!
notes.content:
We have a lot of major updates on the way for all of our games so keep a look out.

Fasaria World Online:

A lot of major changes to the game and a major overhaul of some features are in the works, expect to see a full update to the game very soon.

Angels of Fasaria RPG:

We are working on a new version of Angels of Fasaria RPG from the ground up. This new version will be released as a stand alone game and it is TOTALLY different in comparison from the current version. A lot of major changes and improvements will be included to this newer version so it will be sold as a new game. We are still considering creating a browser based mmo to accompany that version but no absolute decision has been made yet.

Angels of Fasaria Online:

We still have sign ups open for alpha testing for the online game version of Angels of Fasaria. Not a lot of people have signed up or shown interest so development is currently halted. If you want to see the online game be made, sign up and show your support for it. Currently, you can sign up on steam but private testing may occur which will require an NDA and participation will be outside of steam until the game is ready for beta testing.

AoF Chess Club 2.0:

Some nice updates are scheduled for AoF Chess Club 2.0, mainly the translated versions which should open the community to players from around the world. More info soon.

AoF World Online:

We have a community edition in the works which will include the server with scripts for all players to be able to launch and play locally on their computer. We will also open up the workshop giving players freedom to edit and submit their modified versions. This should open this game to the community for further development and growth as we are no longer developing this game.

The partner dlc will allow players to host their own server where trial players will have access to play on for free. Active servers will have the opportunity to migrate to our list of servers reserved for paid players.

notes.title: NSE Circuit November Newsletter
notes.content:
Busy, busy, busy. We have a lot going on in November to talk about. Fasaria World Online is expected to release this month on November 5th and Ancients of Fasaria Chess Club on November 4th. Be sure to get the games if you haven't already. We've also just recently added a new web launcher for each game that makes accessing them from steam a snap. Here are some of the updates and changes to look out for.

Fasaria World Online Updates:

1. We have removed the ability to purchase crystals from our online shop and instead replaced it with an "Elite Sponsorship Package" option.

2. ALL players now will receive 50 crystonian crystals every month for free. Crystals have already been added to all accounts this month so log in and spend it!

Ancients of Fasaria Chess Club Updates:

1. We've added the ability to select up to 5 different chess piece styles and 5 different board colors.

2. We added a chat box for each club.

3. We added a match making lobby where you can now organize matches.

Angels of Fasaria 2.0 Updates:

We are still looking for players to volunteer for testing our upcoming mmo for Angels of Fasaria. If you have the game in your inventory, you qualify to join early testing so sign up on the discussion board.

That's all for now. We have a lot of more updates and good news coming soon, so always check in NSE Circuit for all your latest news and updates.

http://nsecircuit.com

notes.title: Ancients of Fasaria Server DLC Now Available!
notes.content:
Ancients of Fasaria Game Server with Scripts DLC is now available for purchase. The DLC will allow players to be able to launch our server application on their computer and play locally. 

*Your game access will be played locally from your computer but your server will NOT grant you access to have other players join your game. To unlock the multiplayer feature and to have your game listed in our list of playable servers, you will need to become a Partner.

*We will post more information on how to become a partner and run your own private server soon. 

What will be included with your Server DLC: 

1. You will receive our server application and scripts. 

2. You will be able to play Ancients of Fasaria locally from your computer without having to connect to our server. This will give you freedom to play AoF anytime from your computer independent of our network. 

3. You will be able to edit your scripts to fit your desired needs (Unlimited Platinum Tokens, Resources etc.). You can also download user modified scripts or add your own to our workshop on Steam. 

4. You will find official and user submitted tuts on how to modify scripts in our workshop. Free updates of our server and scripts. No extra fees or costs. 

5. No previous scripting knowledge needed. Setting up your server locally is as easy as clicking a few buttons. Editing scripts are also very easy and requires no previous scripting or programming experience.

notes.title: If Ancients of Fasaria isn't for you...
notes.content:
ːaofdefː Ancients of Fasaria is an indie mmorpg supported by a small team of developers. We take to heart every comment and suggestion as our intent is to meet the needs of the players and those who have shown support for our games. All constructive criticism and advice is welcome as we are constantly working hard to do better for our players.

ːaofdefː If you have any concerns or gripes about our game, community, customer service or policies, please let us know in a constructive manner either in private or on the community board. We need to know how to do better for you.

 ːstrongarmː If you purchased Ancients of Fasaria from steam and are displeased with your purchase in any way, please contact us directly from our website and let us know why you were not satisfied with our game and we will replace your purchase with any of our games now or in the future of equal or more value.

ːkeybotː We are always looking for better ways of improving our games and community. If any of our games have not lived up to your expectations, let us know why so we can do better for you, or we can find a way to make it up to you. 

ːkeybotː We do understand that some players can not be appeased no matter how much we try. Our games may not be for everyone (as no game is) and we do try to accommodate every suggestion from our players. If you purchased any of our games and it did not live up to your expectations, we still appreciate your support. Your suggestions, contributions and input is valuable to us regardless if you decide to be an active part of our community.  

ːpowergloveː What we can NOT do is allow or support abusive or malicious behavior in anyway. This is not just to protect our community and our company but it isn't fair to those who have or do show support for the game as it robs them of the opportunity to freely engage in the very thing that they do love. That behavior is unfair to the players and it is unsupported.

ːaofmedː We offer customer and free technical support for everyone who purchased the game. If you have any technical issues, feel free to post on steam discussion boards or contact us directly for immediate support and help.

Contact Us - Technical/Customer Support

ːkeybotː Please feel free to let us know how we can improve on our games and our service. Feel free to comment (observing forum rules). We work hard to make fast replies to all requests and suggestions.
